C0934.title: JD Finance Joins Police to Dismantle Anti-Collection Black-Market Gang
C0934.summary: In January 2024, the Public Security Bureau of Yunmeng County, Hubei Province, deployed substantial police forces in Wuhan and Yunmeng to conduct a synchronized takedown of a black-market gang engaged in anti-collection, proxy rights defense, debt negotiation, and debt optimization activities.
